parameters.name: ecsType
parameters.description: ECS type. Only ECS_ALIYUN is supported for now.

parameters.name: machineInfos
parameters.description: aliyunRegionId: the Alibaba Cloud region where the machine is located; machineSn: the serial number of the machine; instanceName: hostname; ip: host IP address

parameters.name: organizationId
parameters.description: Organization identity, also known as organization ID, in string format. It can be obtained from the Alibaba Cloud DevOps access URL, for example: https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】

parameters.name: tagIds
parameters.description: Tag IDs, separated by commas if multiple

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Host group type. Only ECS is supported for now.
